{'text': '摺疊iPhone雖然為Apple嘅散熱工程團隊帶來新挑戰，但佢哋諗出咗一個巧妙嘅方法，善用裝置嘅鉸鏈設計，將轉化為優勢。以下係詳細內容。', 'paragraph_context': 'While a folding iPhone posed a new challenge for Apple’s thermal engineering team, they came up with a creative way to leverage the device’s hinge to their advantage. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo嘅鉸鏈配備柔性石墨導熱管', 'paragraph_context': 'iPhone Duo’s hinge features a flexible graphite pipe'}

{'text': 'PCMag早前與Apple矽晶工程副總裁Dan Murray，以及該公司熱設計高級經理Banafsheh Barabadi會面，討論A20 Pro晶片嘅架構。', 'paragraph_context': 'PCMag recently sat down with Dan Murray, Apple’s vice president of silicon engineering, and Banafsheh Barabadi, the company’s senior manager of thermal product design, to discuss the architecture of the A20 Pro chip.'}

{'text': '呢款新嘅SoC為iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max及iPhone Duo提供動力，係Apple第一款以此製程生產嘅iPhone晶片，採用2奈米制程，此前該技術首次應用係8月份Mac mini搭載嘅M6晶片。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new SoC, which powers the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo, is Apple’s first iPhone chip built on a 2 nm process, following the technology’s debut with the M6 chip in the Mac mini in August.'}

{'text': '雖然A20 Pro喺設計時已考慮到三款新iPhone，但iPhone Duo版本具備一啲額外功能，包括第二個顯示引擎，可以同時驅動兩個屏幕。', 'paragraph_context': 'And while the A20 Pro was designed with all three new iPhones in mind, the iPhone Duo version packs some additional capabilities. These include a second display engine to run both screens simultaneously.'}

{'text': '以下節錄自PCMag：', 'paragraph_context': 'From PCMag:'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo嘅A20 Pro版本只係稍有唔同。Murray表示：「喺iPhone Duo方面，我哋加入咗第二個顯示引擎，以支援內外屏幕同步運作；加上CPU及GPU效能提升，我哋可以確保兩個屏幕都帶來流暢嘅使用體驗。對於內屏幕，我哋亦加入咗將FaceTime鏡頭置於屏幕下方嘅支援。」', 'paragraph_context': 'The iPhone Duo’s A20 Pro variant is just slightly different. “For iPhone Duo, we added a second display engine to support simultaneous operation of the inner and outer displays,” says Murray, “and with the increased CPU and GPU performance, we ensure we can deliver a smooth user experience across the displays. For the inner display, we also added support for placing the FaceTime camera behind the display.”'}

{'text': '該篇報道深入剖析咗A20 Pro嘅散熱設計，以及Apple為控制溫度而開發嘅新散熱腔，包括Apple所稱嘅「metal over foam」（金屬覆蓋泡棉）材料，iFixit最近喺拆解iPhone 18 Pro時亦有研究呢種物料。', 'paragraph_context': 'The report offers a really interesting, in-depth look at the A20 Pro’s thermals and the new vapor chamber Apple developed to keep them at bay. That includes what Apple calls “metal over foam,” a material that iFixit also examined during its recent teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro.'}

{'text': '第二個關鍵係一種新物料，用嚟連接A20 Pro同散熱腔之間嘅空隙。Barabadi表示：「我哋稱之為metal over foam（金屬覆蓋泡棉），佢基本上喺SoC同散熱腔之間建立咗直接嘅熱傳導及機械柔性耦合，能夠高效地帶走熱量，同時符合系統嚴格嘅機械要求。我哋花咗幾個月時間反覆調整物料特性，先至能夠將佢付諸應用。」', 'paragraph_context': 'The second pillar is a new material that bridges the gap between the A20 Pro and the vapor chamber. “We call it metal over foam,” says Barabadi, and it “basically creates a direct thermal and mechanically compliant coupling between the SoC and the vapor chamber. It is highly effective in removing the heat, meeting the strict mechanical requirements of the system. It took us months of development to get the material properties exactly right to be able to use this material.”'}

{'text': '報道中最引人入勝嘅細節之一，係Apple點樣提升iPhone Duo嘅散熱表現，尤其係要應付喺摺疊後厚度翻倍嘅裝置內散熱嘅難題。', 'paragraph_context': 'Perhaps the most interesting tidbit from the story is what Apple did to improve the iPhone Duo’s thermal performance, particularly given the challenges of dissipating heat in a device that doubles in thickness when folded.'}

{'text': '以下節錄自該篇報道：', 'paragraph_context': 'From the report:'}

{'text': 'Barabadi話：「呢個係設計上技術難度最高嘅環節之一。」為咗解決呢個問題，Apple將一條柔性石墨導熱管穿過鉸鏈本身，將熱量喺兩邊機身之間傳遞，從而增加散熱面積。「呢個部件嘅係我哋熱工程團隊同機械團隊共同協作嘅結晶。佢係一種柔性物料，大家可以想像，佢必須能夠承受無數次鉸鏈屈曲週期，同時保持熱傳導性能及結構完整性，喺產品嘅整個生命週期內都唔會損壞。」', 'paragraph_context': '“This was one of the most technically challenging aspects of our design,” says Barabadi. To surmount the issue, Apple routed a flexible graphite pipe through the hinge itself to transfer heat between the two halves, thereby increasing the surface area available for heat dissipation. “This part need[ed] to be co-engineered between our thermal team and the mechanical team. It’s a flexible material that needs to survive, as you can imagine, many hinge cycles while maintaining its thermal connectivity, and also its structural integrity throughout the product life cycle.”'}

{'text': 'PCMag對Murray同Barabadi嘅專訪亦深入探討咗A20 Pro嘅架構，包括將DRAM置於處理器旁邊而非疊喺上面嘅好處，完整內容可以喺呢度閱讀。', 'paragraph_context': 'PCMag’s interview with Murray and Barabadi also goes into the A20 Pro’s architecture, including the benefits of placing the DRAM next to the processor rather than stacking it on top, and you can read it in full here.'}
